subject: Pilot demo — executive attendance and narrow-window options
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@pioneertech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot demo — executive attendance and narrow-window options

Hi Elaine,

Thanks again for the time on Friday — excited about PioneerTech potentially piloting Redwood inference for your support summarization workflow. To make the session productive for your leadership, we'd like to lock in a short exec-facing demo (15–20 minutes) that focuses on latency, isolation, and runbook for failover. Can you confirm whether the CIO or VP of Eng can join? If neither can make it we can run the product portion and have our Head of Product join as an exec proxy.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Option A: Wed Oct 5, 2027 — 10:00–10:30
- Option B: Thu Oct 6, 2027 — 08:30–09:00

If you have a hard constraint, tell me which slot to hold and we'll propose a backfill/coverage plan for leadership. Attaching a concise exec deck and our SOC2 summary for your security team to scan ahead of time.

Next steps:
- Confirm preferred slot and which exec will attend
- Tell us whether you'd prefer a 15-min exec overview + 30-min deep-dive or a single 40-min session

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood-Exec-Deck-v3.pdf (attachment stub), SaaS-SOC2-summary.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Elaine Park <elaine@pioneertech.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — executive attendance and narrow-window options

Hi Priyom — thanks, we appreciated the overview. I can get our CIO, Martin Lopez, into a short slot but October 5 is tight: he has a board walk-through that morning. Can you do either:

- Tue Oct 4 — 11:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Oct 5 — 16:00–16:30 PT (later in the day)

Also, two asks from my side so we can get approvals fast:
1) Can you trim the deck to 8–10 slides focused on business metrics, cost per 1M tokens, and our isolation options?
2) Our security team will want a one-page SOC2 summary and a contact for follow-up questions (they require a named person).

If you can send the condensed deck and a point of contact I can loop Martin and our SecOps lead before we lock the slot.

Best,
Elaine Park
Director, Strategic Partnerships | PioneerTech
elaine@pioneertech.com | +1 (206) 555-0147
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@pioneertech.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — executive attendance and narrow-window options

Hi Elaine — looping in as Redwood's executive sponsor for the PioneerTech pilot.

Quick responses to your asks and coverage plan:
- We can absolutely compress the deck to an 8-slide exec version focused on cost, SLOs, and tenancy options; attaching the trimmed PDF.
- SOC2 one-pager is attached (SaaS-SOC2-summary.pdf). For SecOps follow-up, please reach out to Vicki Huang (vicki@redwood.com), our Head of Security — she'll handle any evidence requests.

On availability: Martin's suggested windows work for us. If Oct 4 11:00 PT is preferred we will confirm Marissa (me) + Rishi as backup for Martin so leadership is covered even if something comes up. If you prefer Oct 5 16:00 PT, I can attend that slot and Rishi will be on the deep-dive.

Coverage/backfill note (if CIO drops):
- Primary: Martin Lopez (PioneerTech, confirmed availability pending his calendar)
- Exec backup from Redwood: Marissa Cole (Executive Sponsor) — will handle business questions and SLA commitments
- Deep dive owner: Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Architect) — will cover technical runbook and failover behavior

Attachments: Redwood-Exec-Deck-v3-condensed.pdf (8 slides), SaaS-SOC2-summary.pdf

Let me know which of the two windows you want to hold and we will send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0128
From: Elaine Park <elaine@pioneertech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — executive attendance and narrow-window options

Thanks Marissa — please hold Tue Oct 4 11:00–11:30 PT. I've looped Martin and SecOps; Martin's assistant will confirm formally but he expects to attend. Once you send the invite with the 8-slide deck and Vicki's contact I'll finalize.

Appreciate the quick turn-around.

— Elaine
